title: fix(dashboard,core): one declaration of which chart families ignore compareTo; the dashboard stops running the comparison query for pie / donut / funnel / scatter (#7495)
body:
Fixes #7495
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

Ruling 5749199335 (letter A), ratified as 5809246443: one predicate in `@object-ui/core`'s `chart-presentation`, read by both `plugin-charts` and `plugin-dashboard`; the dashboard stops running the comparison query for pie, donut, funnel and scatter.

- **`@object-ui/core`**: new export `chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo(chartType)` in `chart-presentation.ts`. It reaches the package entry through the existing `export * from './utils/chart-presentation.js'`, so `index.ts` is not edited. It answers `true` for `pie` / `donut` / `funnel` / `scatter`, and `false` for every other spec chart family, an unknown string, the empty string, a case variant, and `undefined`. The docblock states the rule, the reason per family and why it lives in core, and cites objectui#7495.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-charts`**: ObjectChart's local `supportsCompareTo` is deleted. Both call sites (the comparison fetch and the overlay-series synthesis) read `!chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo(schema.chartType)`. The answers equal the retired predicate's for every input, so behaviour is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`**: DatasetWidget's `chartIgnoresCompareTo = chartType === 'scatter'` copy is deleted. `compareTo` is now decided once, near the top of the component: it is `undefined` when the widget reaches the chart branch (`!isMetric && !isTable`) and its chart family (after `CHART_TYPE_MAP`: `pyramid` to `funnel`, `bubble` to `scatter`) ignores `compareTo`. Every downstream reader follows from that one value: no `compareTo` in the `queryDataset` selection, no window lowered into `timeDimensions` (the window stays in `runtimeFilter`, byte-identical to the same widget with no `compareTo`), an empty `comparedValues`, and no overlay series. `chartType` moved up from the chart branch to feed that decision, so it is still declared once.

**Done-when (mechanical).** At HEAD, `git grep -nE "IgnoresCompareTo|supportsCompareTo|IGNORING_COMPARE_TO" -- 'packages/*/src/**' 'apps/*/src/**' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!**/*.test.*'` lists ONE list declaration (`CHART_TYPES_IGNORING_COMPARE_TO` in core's chart-presentation) and its readers: the exported function, two call sites in ObjectChart, and one in DatasetWidget. No `=== 'scatter'` compare-to guard remains in the dashboard.

## Behaviour change and risk reading

- **Server side:** a compare-to dataset chart widget of type pie, donut, funnel, pyramid, scatter or bubble now makes the executor run ONE pass instead of two. Nothing a user saw is removed. The renderer's pie and funnel arms draw only `series[0]`, and objectui#7402 had already suppressed the scatter overlay.
- **One visible change, in the ruled direction:** the dataset executor refuses a `compareTo` that has no single dated window (objectstack `service-analytics` `dataset-executor.ts`, "compareTo needs a dated window to shift"). The widget used to render that refusal in place of the chart. A widget of an ignoring family now draws its chart. This is pinned both ways: the pie renders, and the bar control still shows the refusal.
- **Reachability:** `compareTo` appears in 0 files under `examples/**` in this repo, re-measured at `3861a6a6d`, while the control `"type": "bar"` hits 5 `examples/**/*.json` files (the same reading as triage comment 5548747753). Tenant incidence is not measurable from here.
- **Not changed:**
  - Metric, gauge, table and pivot widgets keep `compareTo`.
  - A `pie` widget with NO dimensions renders as a metric tile, which shows the comparison as a delta, so it keeps it. The gate is the chart branch, not the widget type.
  - Line, area, bar, horizontal-bar and combo keep the overlay.
  - Per the ruling, the renderer is not taught to consume a comparison series for pie.
- **Revert:** one PR revert.

## Hunk positions (objectui#10169 overlap)

`chart-presentation.ts`: this PR's only hunk is `@@ -440,3 +440,48 @@`. The predicate is appended after `chartConfigPresentation`, at the end of the file. #10169 edits `@@ -84`, `@@ -105` and `@@ -217`. Measured: `git apply --check` of #10169's three chart-presentation hunks against this branch head exits 0. `packages/core/src/index.ts` is not edited.

## Tests (HEAD `3861a6a6d`)

New pins:
- `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/chart-presentation.compareTo-7495.test.ts`: the predicate over every `ChartTypeSchema.options` family from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (read at run time), plus `undefined`, an unknown string, the empty string, case variants, and `bubble` / `pyramid` (false, because the caller maps them to a family first). It also pins the package-entry export identity.
- `packages/plugin-charts/src/__tests__/ObjectChart.compareTo.corePredicate-7495.test.tsx`:
  - pie, donut and funnel make one aggregate call and get no overlay. These were not pinned before; scatter already was.
  - The core predicate is wrapped in a spy whose answer the test can force. Forced true on a bar, the fetch and the overlay are suppressed. Forced false on a pie, both run. A truthful bar control keeps both.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.compareTo.ignoredFamilies-7495.test.tsx`:
  - For the widget types pie, donut, funnel, pyramid, scatter and bubble: the selection has no `compareTo` and no `timeDimensions`, it equals the no-compareTo selection, and the chart gets one series only.
  - Controls: bar and line still forward the comparison, lower the window and get the overlay.
  - A dimensionless pie (metric tile) keeps the comparison.
  - An undated-filter pie renders, while the bar control shows the refusal.

## Ablations

Each ablation ran after the fix was committed, with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from objectstack. Each restore was proven on disk.

1. **Dashboard pointed back at `chartType === 'scatter'`** (anchor: the `chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo(chartType)` term in the `compareTo` decision). Result: 13 failed, 13 passed of 26. Every pie, donut, funnel and pyramid pin (3 each) went red, and so did the undated-filter pie pin. The scatter and bubble pins and every control stayed green. Blob `19d85e1ea29d` went to `aa355d627edc` and was restored to `19d85e1ea29d`, equal to HEAD, with an empty `git diff HEAD`.
2. **ObjectChart's fetch site pointed back at a local four-family list.** Result: the two forced-answer pins went red (2 failed, 4 passed). The restored blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

No build was needed between the mutation and the run. The tests load the edited modules from `src`: DatasetWidget and ObjectChart by relative import, and `@object-ui/core` through the root vitest alias to `packages/core/src`.

Each paragraph was re-read: none describes a line this PR changes, and all still hold.
- Hand-derived family, because this repo has no dispatch-gates deriver. All exit 0:
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`
  - `check:test-path-roots`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:self-import`
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:esm-specifiers`
  - `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:i18n-keys`
- `check:readme-exports`: not run. No README is edited, and the gate judges only README imports.
- ESLint, narrowed to the touched files (a measurement, not a skip):
  1. Population: the root `eslint.config.js`. Every package's `lint` script is `eslint .`, and core, plugin-charts and plugin-dashboard have no package-level config, so that script uses the root config.
  2. Count: `--format json` over the 6 touched TS/TSX files reports 6 files, 0 errors and 59 warnings. Base vs head for the three edited sources: `chart-presentation.ts` 0/0 to 0/0, `ObjectChart.tsx` 0/36 to 0/36, `DatasetWidget.tsx` 0/11 to 0/11.
  3. Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`), and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move the verdict for any untouched file.

## Changeset

`.changeset/7495-compareto-one-predicate.md` declares `minor` on `@object-ui/core` (a new export) and on `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` (a query stops running). `@object-ui/plugin-charts` is not declared: its behaviour is byte-for-byte unchanged (the same answers at both call sites), and the body says so.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/SKILL.md` already says "Pie, donut, funnel and scatter charts ignore `compareTo`". That was true of the drawing and is now true of the query as well. The file is not edited; it is outside the claim's file surface.
- The declared union `ObjectChartSchema['chartType']` omits `funnel`, yet DashboardRenderer's object-chart path passes `funnel` through at run time. The new charts pin casts at one call and says why. Noted, not filed: nothing shows that the narrower prop type rejects or drops authored metadata.
- The header of `DatasetWidget.compareTo.scatter.test.tsx` says the executor "DID return" the `__compare` column. Its double still returns that column unconditionally, so the sentence and its assertions remain true. Left as is.
